title: 第2章 异质

第2章 异质
“如果是活人的话，可能真的是与紫光有关……但也或许是一个陷阱。”
许青目露思索，沉吟起来。
他在废墟城池这些天，深刻的知晓那些被神灵气息污染，化成异兽的存在，每一头都凶残无比，力大无穷。
但或许是禁区还没有彻底形成的缘故，这些异兽在白天时，大都沉睡。
除非是如他上次获取竹简时，闯入了它们沉睡之地的外围区域。
否则的话平日里小心一些，并无大碍。
而相对于它们，许青更警惕的是活人，因为有些时候人心比凶兽险恶。
于是思索后，他的眼神慢慢冷厉，不管是不是活人，是不是陷阱，那片区域……他都准备再去一次。
只不过前往时，需要做好十足的准备。
想到这里，许青抓紧了手中的修行竹简。
这数日来的修炼，身体的变化让他有了一些底气，脑海也不由浮现出竹简内容中，除功法外，对于修行的介绍。
修行，传承于神灵残面没有到来前的古老岁月。
如今虽有改变，但总体还是延续了曾经的体系。
分为凝气、筑基、结丹、元婴。
至于元婴之后，或许是境界太高，竹简上没有记录，但其上却清晰的点明了修士修行的无奈。
因神灵的气息侵袭了灵能，使灵能被污染，这种污染对于万物来说如剧毒。
不知从什么时候开始，大家将神灵的气息，称呼为异质。
许青很清楚，自己之前修行时感受到的冰寒，实际上就是吸入的灵能内混合了异质的缘故。
这种异质一旦在体内累积到一定程度，就会使修士异化，要么暴毙成为血雾，要么化作没有神智的异兽。

而神灵睁开眼看向的区域，异质浓度瞬间暴增，实际上就是将这一变化瞬间加速罢了。
修行，存在危险。
可不去修行的话，在这个充满神灵气息污染的末土世界，人们的寿命普遍降低，且恶疾多发，如同活在九幽炼狱之中，几乎无人能善终。
所以修行，就成为了没有选择后，唯一的道路。
于是无数年来，人们根据传承，演变出了一代代的修炼之法。
如今流传的，是吸收灵能的同时，利用功法，将混杂在灵能中的异质，分离出来，压缩在身体的某一个位置。
这个位置，被称为异化点。
因此，分离异质的比例，也就成为了区分功法优劣的重要标准。
且几乎所有的高分离比例功法，都是被大的势力或者家族所掌握，那是他们重要的资源，这一点，无论神灵是否到来，实际上都是一样的。
而根据所修功法的不同，分离异质的程度的不一样，异化点存在的区域也因此不同。
但无论如何，只要修炼，就会有异质，就会慢慢形成异化点。
而异化点理论上是不可逆的，虽能通过一些丹药来化解，但也治标不治本。
至于彻底净化异化点的方法，竹简里也提了一句。
在末土世界中，除南凰洲外，还存在了更为磅礴的大陆，名为望古。
那里有人族的起源地，虽也在神灵气息污染之中，可似乎已经找到了能彻底净化的办法。
但显然这种办法不可量化，唯有极其尊贵之人，才可享有。
寻常修士，可望不可求。
至于数量最多的低阶散修，就更是没有可能获得了。
而散修的功法大都在分离程度上极低，所以不但修炼艰难，异化的风险也是更大。
尽管修行风险如此之大，可对于大多数人而言，修士的身影，也还是常见的。

比如许青，他知道现在的自己，也可以算是一个散修了。
虽然按照竹简上的记录，末土世界的修士，每个人都是走在一条艰难且凶险的不归路上，就如同凡人游向深海，奔向那遥不可及的彼岸。
可往往还不曾看到传说的彼岸，就已然力竭而亡。
但贫民窟长大的许青，深刻的知晓一次冲突，一场疾病，都会让人失去生命。
“所以与其去担心未来异化，不如去担心明天是否还活着。”
许青喃喃，摸了摸胸口的伤痕，看向缝隙外的天色。
此刻外面距离天亮似已不远，嘶吼与凄厉之音，也都少了很多。
“如果血雨一直继续，且还没有找到紫光的话，就要考虑离开，去其他城池寻找药草了。”许青低头看向自己的伤口。
因为神灵气息的弥漫以及血雨的持续，城池内几乎所有的物品都被严重污染，药草也在其中，资源很是匮乏。
许青抬手，在自己胸口伤痕上按了一下，血水渗出了一些。
他的面色有些苍白，深吸口气，将皮袄内的衣衫脱下，从后背环绕，绑住自己的伤口后，他打起精神，默默等待天亮。
时间不长，外界的嘶吼与凄厉越发减少。
直至完全消失，许青透过缝隙注意到外面的天色已经蒙蒙亮。
根据他以往的经验，此刻是可以外出的。
但他没有立刻动身，而是站起身活动了一下有些僵直的身躯。
直至泛起阵阵温热后，他挪开堵住缝隙的石头杂物，借助外面传来的微弱光亮，
一把满是铁锈的匕首，被他绑在了小腿旁。
那根乌黑色的铁签，被他放在了最顺手可拿的位置。
还有一个蛇头，被他用麻布包裹，小心的
做完这些，许青闭上眼，几个呼吸后猛地睁开，目中已被冷静取代。

他飞速钻出缝隙，在出口处停顿。
警惕的四下查看后，确定无碍，许青猛地一冲，在天色逐渐明亮中，到了外界。
向着前方疾驰而去。
因血雨不断，云层密布，所以这里的天亮看不见太阳，更不会有强烈的阳光。
昏暗的晨曦如同一个长满了寿斑的病重老人，那浑浊的目光，似乎依旧残留着夜晚的寒霜。
而吐出的气息，化作了清晨的风，吹来死亡的味道，很冷，很寒。
若是没有热身的话，被风一吹全身都会不由自主的发抖。
但对于许青而言，他身体还保留之前的温热，所以没有受到太大影响。
此刻速度不减，直奔昨日看到的存在疑似活人的区域。
远远望去，空旷的城池内，许青的身影如豹，跳跃在一处处断壁残垣之上，行云流水没有丝毫停顿。
而伴随他的，是天空飞过的一群飞鸟，只是它们的位置很高，难以捕捉。
疾驰中，许青抬头看了眼天空的飞鸟，舔了舔嘴唇。
他也不知什么原因，神灵睁眼后，众生万物被污染，几乎全部死亡，也包含了兽类，可唯独鸟类存活最多。
而这些鸟，就是他这段时间狩猎解饥的重点。
同时，鸟类虽也被困在血雨里，可它们似乎本能的可以寻找到一些安全的庇护点，如许青的地洞，之前就是顺着鸟的踪迹发现。
这种庇护点实际上也并非绝对安全，只是相对而言，似乎更容易被那些异兽与诡异所忽略。
许青这些时间发现了两处，一处是其石洞，另一处则是城主府外。
但此刻他只是在天空扫了扫，就收回目光，锁定了这城池的一处方位，越来越近。
很快，许青就临近了昨日所看的区域，他没有直接过去，而是绕了一圈找了一处高点。
小心谨慎的爬上去后，他趴了下来，一动不动，眼睛眯起尽可能不露光芒，缓缓低头看了过去。

一眼看去，许青目中眼眸一紧，他再次看到了昨日的那个人！
对方靠在残垣旁坐着，衣着整齐，皮肤正常。
最重要的是……他的神态，他的身体，他的一切竟与昨天许青所望，一模一样。
仿佛一整夜的时间，对方没有动弹一下。
这极不合理。
对方若是活人，城池黑夜内存在的危险，不可能对其视若无睹。
对方若是死人，这没有被污染的尸体，是那些异兽最好的食物，所以一样不可能存在到现在。
许青沉默，内心思索后他趴在那里一动不动，贫民窟长大的他，不缺少耐心。
于是就这样，在他的小心凝望下，时间慢慢流逝，直至晌午过去，那人依旧一动不动。
已经等了三个时辰的许青，沉吟后右手轻轻抬起，一粒石子被他抓在手中，向着对方所在之地，激射而出。
这石子速度很快，冲击力不小，落在残垣处身影的身上时，发出砰的一声。
那身影随之摇晃，竟如尸体般向一旁倒了下去。
而在他倒下的一刻，一缕紫芒，在他曾经坐着的地面上，显露出来。
看到紫芒的瞬间，许青眼睛里露出精光，呼吸急促。
他找了这些天，找的就是曾经看到的降临在城池内的紫光。
此刻他强行克制立刻过去的冲动，又艰难的等了片刻，确定无碍后，他猛地冲出。
速度之快几乎爆发出全部力量，整个人如一头猎鹰，直奔紫光所在。
急速到来后，他一把将紫光抓起，身影毫不迟疑激射倒退远离。
整个过程速度极快，直至退后了十多丈外，许青才气喘吁吁停下身子，看向手中抓着的发出紫光之物。
那是一枚紫色的水晶，晶莹剔透，有一种炫目之美。

许青心脏怦怦加速跳动，抬头时，他看到了那倒下的尸体，似乎因失去了紫光的庇护，此刻衣衫肉眼可见的腐蚀，皮肤也瞬息成为了青黑。
这一幕，让许青本能的将手里的紫色水晶，抓的更紧，转身向着自己的地洞，飞速奔跑。
而在奔跑不久，许青脚步忽然一顿，神色有些迷惑。
低头解开自己的皮袄，看向自己绑住的胸口。
那里已经没有血水渗出，反倒是有阵阵痒的感觉浮现。
许青双目一凝，撕开自己绷住伤痕的残衣，看向伤口时他心神强烈震动。
他明明记得清晨检查时，伤势还没有愈合，甚至发黑更多，可现在……
他的胸口伤痕，竟已愈合了大半，边缘位置更是只剩下了一道浅痕！
“这……”许青呼吸急促，随后猛地看向手里的紫色水晶。
(本章完)

Chapter 2 Heterogeneous
"If it is a living person, it may really be related to the purple light... but it may also be a trap."
Xu Qing's eyes showed contemplation and he began to ponder.
During these days in the ruined city, he became deeply aware of the existences that were contaminated by the aura of the gods and turned into strange beasts. Each one was extremely ferocious and powerful.
But perhaps because the restricted area has not yet been completely formed, most of these strange beasts are asleep during the day.
Unless it was like the last time he obtained the bamboo slips, he broke into the outer area of ​​​​their sleeping place.
Otherwise, if you just be careful on weekdays, it won't be a big deal.
Compared with them, Xu Qing is more wary of living people, because sometimes people's hearts are more sinister than ferocious beasts.
So after thinking about it, his eyes gradually became cold and stern. Regardless of whether it was a living person or a trap, he was ready to go to that area again.
But when you go, you need to be fully prepared.
Thinking of this, Xu Qing clutched the bamboo slips in his hand.
The changes in his body during the past few days of practice gave him some confidence, and his mind couldn't help but think of the introduction to practice in addition to the exercises in the bamboo slips.
Cultivation is passed down from the ancient years before the arrival of the residual face of the gods.
Although there have been changes now, the overall system has continued as before.
It is divided into Qi Condensation, Foundation Establishment, Pill Formation, and Nascent Soul.
As for those after Nascent Soul, they may have reached too high a level and there is no record on the bamboo slips, but it clearly points out the helplessness of the monks in their practice.
Because the breath of the gods invades the spiritual energy, the spiritual energy is polluted. This pollution is like poison to all living things.
I don’t know since when, everyone started calling the breath of the gods as alien.
Xu Qing knew very well that the coldness he felt during his previous practice was actually due to the heterogeneity mixed in the spiritual energy he inhaled.
Once this heterogeneity accumulates to a certain extent in the body, the monk will be alienated and either die suddenly and become a blood mist, or turn into a mindless beast.
In the area where the god opened his eyes and looked, the concentration of heterogeneity increased instantly. In fact, this change was accelerated instantly.
There are dangers in practicing.
But if you don't practice cultivation, in this apocalyptic world full of pollution from the aura of gods, people's lifespans are generally reduced, and diseases are common. It's like living in the Nine Nether Purgatory, and almost no one can die a good death.
Therefore, practice has become the only way after there is no choice.
So for countless years, people evolved the cultivation method from generation to generation based on inheritance.
What is being circulated today is that while absorbing spiritual energy, one uses techniques to separate out the foreign matter mixed in the spiritual energy and compress it in a certain position of the body.
This location is called the alienation point.
Therefore, the proportion of separated heterogeneity has become an important criterion for distinguishing the quality of exercises.
And almost all high separation ratio skills are controlled by large forces or families, which are their important resources. This fact is actually the same whether the gods come or not.
Depending on the method practiced, the degree of separation and heterogeneity is different, and therefore the area where the alienation point exists is also different.
But no matter what, as long as you practice, there will be differences, and points of alienation will gradually form.
The alienation point is theoretically irreversible. Although it can be resolved through some elixirs, it only treats the symptoms but not the root cause.
As for the method to completely purify the alienation point, there is also a mention in the bamboo slips.
In the end world, in addition to Nanhuang Continent, there is also a more majestic continent called Wanggu.
Although the origin of the human race there is also polluted by the aura of the gods, it seems that a method has been found to completely purify it.
But obviously this method cannot be quantified, and only extremely noble people can enjoy it.
Ordinary monks can only hope for it.
As for the largest number of low-level casual cultivators, it is even more impossible to obtain them.
Most of the exercises of casual cultivators have a very low degree of separation, so not only is it difficult to practice, but the risk of alienation is also greater.
exhaustAlthough the risks of cultivation are so great, for most people, the sight of monks is still common.
For example, Xu Qing knows that he can now be regarded as a casual cultivator.
Although according to the records on the bamboo slips, every monk in the end world is walking on a difficult and dangerous road of no return, just like a mortal swimming into the deep sea, rushing towards the unreachable shore.
But often they die of exhaustion before even seeing the other side of the legend.
But Xu Qing, who grew up in a slum, knows deeply that a conflict or a disease can cause people to lose their lives.
“So instead of worrying about future alienation, it’s better to worry about whether you’ll be alive tomorrow.”
Xu Qing murmured, touched the scar on his chest, and looked at the sky outside the gap.
At this moment, it seemed that dawn was not far away outside, and the roars and shrill sounds were much less numerous.
"If the blood rain continues and the purple light has not been found, we should consider leaving and looking for herbs in other cities." Xu Qing looked down at his wound.
Because of the pervasive aura of the gods and the continuous rain of blood, almost all items in the city were seriously contaminated, including medicinal herbs, and resources were very scarce.
Xu Qing raised his hand and pressed on the scar on his chest, and some blood seeped out.
His face was a little pale. He took a deep breath, took off the clothes under his leather jacket, wrapped it around his back, and tied his wounds. He braced himself and waited silently for dawn.
After a short time, the roar and screams from the outside world became less and less.
Until it disappeared completely, Xu Qing noticed through the gap that the sky outside was already bright.
Based on his past experience, he can go out at this moment.
But he didn't move immediately. Instead, he stood up and moved his somewhat stiff body.
After bursts of warmth began to appear, he moved away the stones and debris blocking the gap, and with the help of the faint light coming from outside,
A rusty dagger was tied to his calf.
The black iron stick was placed in the most convenient position for him to hold.
There was also a snake head, which he carefully wrapped in linen.
After doing this, Xu Qing closed his eyes, and after a few breaths, he opened them suddenly, and his eyes were replaced by calmness.
He quickly slipped through the gap and paused at the exit.
After looking around vigilantly, and confirming that there was no problem, Xu Qing rushed to the outside world as the sky gradually became brighter.
Galloping towards the front.
Due to the continuous rain of blood and dense clouds, the sun cannot be seen here at dawn, let alone strong sunlight.
The dim morning light looked like a seriously ill old man covered in age spots, and his cloudy eyes seemed to still contain the frost of the night.
And the breath he exhaled turned into the morning wind, blowing the smell of death, very cold.
If you don't warm up, your whole body will tremble involuntarily when the wind blows.
But for Xu Qing, his body still retained the warmth it had before, so it wasn't affected much.
At this moment, the speed did not slow down, and he went straight to the area where there were suspected living people seen yesterday.
Looking from afar, in the empty city, Xu Qing's figure was like a leopard, jumping over the broken walls and ruins, and the flowing clouds and water did not stop at all.
Accompanying him were a group of birds flying in the sky, but they were located very high and difficult to catch.
While galloping, Xu Qing looked up at the birds in the sky and licked his lips.
He didn't know why, but after the gods opened their eyes, all living things were polluted and almost all died, including beasts, but only birds survived the most.
These birds were the focus of his hunting to satisfy his hunger during this period.
At the same time, although birds are also trapped in the blood rain, they seem to be able to find some safe shelter instinctively, such as Xu Qing's burrow, which was discovered by following the traces of birds.
In fact, this kind of shelter is not absolutely safe, but relatively speaking, it seems to be easier to be ignored by those strange beasts and weirdness.
Xu Qing discovered two places during these times, oneIt's the cave, and the other place is outside the city lord's palace.
But at this moment, he just scanned the sky, then withdrew his gaze and locked on a location in the city, getting closer and closer.
Soon, Xu Qing approached the area he was looking at yesterday. Instead of going directly, he circled around to find a high point.
After climbing up carefully, he lay down and remained motionless. He narrowed his eyes to hide as much light as possible and slowly lowered his head to look over.
At a glance, Xu Qing's eyes tightened. He saw the person from yesterday again!
The other person was sitting next to the ruins, neatly dressed and with normal skin.
The most important thing is... his demeanor, his body, everything about him is exactly the same as what Xu Qing saw yesterday.
It seemed like the whole night, the other party didn't move.
This is extremely unreasonable.
If the other party is alive, it is impossible to turn a blind eye to the dangers that exist in the dark night of the city.
If the other party is a dead person, this uncontaminated corpse is the best food for those alien beasts, so it is impossible for him to exist until now.
Xu Qing was silent. After thinking in his heart, he lay there motionless. Having grown up in a slum, he did not lack patience.
So, under his careful gaze, time passed slowly, until noon passed, and the man remained motionless.
Xu Qing, who had been waiting for three hours, raised his right hand slightly after hesitating. He grabbed a stone in his hand and shot it towards the opponent's location.
The stone was very fast and had a strong impact. When it fell on the figure in the ruins, it made a bang.
The figure shook and fell to the side like a corpse.
And the moment he fell, a ray of purple light appeared on the ground where he once sat.
The moment he saw the purple light, Xu Qing's eyes flashed and his breathing became rapid.
He had been searching for these days, looking for the purple light he had seen descending on the city.
At this moment, he forcibly resisted the urge to go there immediately, and waited for a moment with difficulty. After making sure that there was no problem, he rushed out.
The speed was so fast that almost all the power exploded, and the whole person was like a falcon, heading straight towards the purple light.
After arriving quickly, he grabbed the purple light, and the figure shot backwards away without hesitation.
The whole process was extremely fast. It was not until he had retreated more than ten feet that Xu Qing stopped panting and looked at the purple-light object in his hand.
It was a purple crystal, crystal clear, with a dazzling beauty.
Xu Qing's heart was beating rapidly. When he looked up, he saw the fallen body. It seemed that because it had lost the protection of the purple light, the clothes were visibly corroded and the skin instantly turned black.
This scene made Xu Qing instinctively grasp the purple crystal in his hand tighter, turn around and run quickly towards his cave.
Not long after running, Xu Qing suddenly stopped and looked a little confused.
He lowered his head to untie his leather jacket and looked at his tied chest.
There was no blood seeping out there, but instead there was an itching sensation.
Xu Qing's eyes narrowed, and he tore open the remaining clothes that were holding the scar. When he looked at the wound, he was greatly shocked.
He clearly remembered that when he checked in the morning, the injury had not healed yet and had even turned darker, but now...
Most of the scars on his chest have healed, and there is only a shallow mark left on the edge!
"This..." Xu Qing breathed quickly, and then suddenly looked at the purple crystal in his hand.
(End of chapter)
